questions.question: What kind of review do you want for trello-mcp?

options.label: Code quality audit
options.description: Full read of src/: architecture, code smells, error handling, maintainability, test coverage. General health assessment.

options.label: Security review
options.description: Focus on auth/token handling, input validation, SSRF/injection risks, the HTTP/SSE surface — it's an MCP server handling Trello API credentials.

options.label: Adoption eval
options.description: Is it worth using? Maturity, features, dependencies, maintenance status, how it compares to alternatives.

options.label: Review the v1.7.0 branch
options.description: Diff origin/chore/release-1.7.0 (or another feature branch) against main and review those specific changes.
